design_philosophy.description: A hybrid design bridging the professional trust of LinkedIn with the dynamic, youthful energy of Welcome to the Jungle. The interface balances high-density information for companies with an approachable, modern, and tactile experience for Gen Z candidates.
core_principles: Trust & Vibrancy: Professional structural foundation mixed with energetic color accents.
Cardless When Possible: Reduce nested boxes. Use generous negative space and subtle borders.
Tactile Surfaces: Very light shadows combined with rounded elements (rounded-2xl) for a physical feel.
Optical Alignment: Elements must flow naturally; prioritize left-alignment for dense text and center-alignment for hero calls-to-action.

primary_blue.usage: Primary buttons, trusted professional actions, active tabs.

modern_purple.usage: Accents, youth-focused features, tags, highlights, and secondary calls-to-action.

status_green.usage: Online status in messaging, active available candidate status, success toasts.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. We reject standard 'Inter' for headings to avoid a generic SaaS look. Instead, we use Outfit for friendly but professional headings, and Figtree for crisp data density.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous padding is mandatory. p-6, p-8, and p-12 should be prioritized over p-4.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: For dashboard and profile sections, use the 'Control Room' grid with tight gaps (gap-6) but generous internal card padding (p-8).
layout_and_spacing.radius: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and buttons to evoke a friendly, modern feel.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for floating elements. Avoid harsh, dark shadows.

navigation.style: Fixed top bar, Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200).
navigation.elements: Logo, Central Search Bar, Navigation Links, Profile Avatar / CTA, Notifications.

hero_section.style: Text-heavy with asymmetric layout or dynamic bento grid. Use modern purple and professional blue abstract SVG blobs or gradients blurred in the background.
hero_section.slogan: Trouve ton stage ou ton alternance près de chez toi

search_and_filters.style: Centralized large input field (rounded-full) with high contrast. Sidebar filters use clean toggles and checkboxes (Shadcn customized).

interactive_map.library: react-simple-maps or standard SVG France map
interactive_map.style: Clean geometric rendering. Regions highlighted in soft blue/purple depending on data density. Tooltips on hover with company counts.

social_feed.style: Facebook-style but polished. Flat cards (rounded-2xl) with 1px border. Composer at the top. Engagement buttons (Like, Comment, Share) using minimal outlined icons.

profiles.style: LinkedIn-style but younger. Large cover photo, overlapping avatar (border-4 border-white). Clean sections for skills, experience, and 'About Me'.

messaging.style: Split pane (List on left, Chat on right). Online indicators using status_green. Chat bubbles in primary_blue (outgoing) and surface/grey (incoming).

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons use -translate-y-0.5 and subtle shadow increase. Text colors explicitly defined on hover to maintain contrast.
interactions_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='apply-button', data-testid='search-input').

icons_and_assets.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for marketing, Regular for dashboard) or lucide-react if constrained.

implementation_instructions: Use standard HTML tags augmented heavily with Tailwind classes for layout structures (do not rely purely on Shadcn Sections or Cards for marketing pages).

Integrate Shadcn primitives (Input, Button, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Dialog) for forms, the central search bar, filter sidebars, and interactive modals. Adjust their border radii to rounded-2xl to match the youth vibe.
For the France map, you may use SVG path mapping with d3-geo or react-simple-maps, mapping regions and using hover states to show 'XX Companies Recruiting'.
Never use pure black or pure grey. Background is #F8FAFC. Main text is #0F172A.
Implement the Facebook-style social feed with dynamic post layout, utilizing real images from the assets provided and ensuring data-testids exist on every action button (like, comment, share, apply).
Profile pages should combine standard dashboard utility (for editing info) with a clean, public-facing aesthetic (for viewing).
